notes: Three parts. (1) 0x57b470-0x57d340 finishes an object file started in slice 12: a C++/STL (vector, map, operator new, C++ EH) parser for DirectX device 'Requirements'/'propertyset'/'applytoall' data plus its container internals; it is shared with the config.txt reader so I kept it in shell, but it may really be Microsoft-supplied device-detection library code (lib:other) - confidence deliberately low. (2) 0x57d410-0x57f3f0 is Halo's Windows startup layer: config.txt parsing, DxDiag/ddraw hardware detection, registry under Software\Microsoft\Microsoft Games\Halo, the 'Halo - Error' message window (FUN_57ea70, 22 engine-wide callers), strings.dll localisation load and the DigitalProductID CD-key hash - all reached from FUN_005411e0; three dialog-resource/control-subclass helpers inside it are labelled dialogs. (3) From 0x57f5de to the end of the slice is one contiguous D3DX static-library run. Confirmed by FUN_592cfa referencing 'DisablePSGP'/'DisableD3DXPSGP' (Processor Specific Graphics Pipeline dispatch) - the ~120 tiny stubs that call FUN_592cfa(1) and then jump through a function-pointer table are D3DX math PSGP dispatch stubs; by FUN_5840a3 reading HKLM Software\Microsoft\Direct3D; and by the image codecs behind D3DXLoadSurfaceFromFile (FUN_5858b3 calls a png_create_read_struct-style API with version literal '1.0.5' plus __setjmp3, FUN_584df0 uses the libjpeg-style setjmp path into 0x5b8xxx). The trailing mass of near-identical functions calling FUN_58a619/FUN_58b22c/FUN_58b1bc/FUN_58b4ae are per-opcode/per-format handlers in the same library and continue into slice 14.
